decisions.reason: As a renamed successor to an already well-liked machine, it has positive early market validation and low uncertainty, so the option should clearly be kept open.
A dedicated product page signals meaningful commitment, and after only one year there is still too little evidence to justify abandoning this mobile shredder option.
Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, its prospects are more uncertain, but in German machinery markets that alone is not enough reason to drop it so early.
The stationary electric fine shredder likely extends the firm's core technology base, so the firm would usually keep this option alive until demand becomes clearer.
Its focus on green waste suggests a specific niche application, and with limited time on the market the option value of waiting still outweighs immediate withdrawal.
Its own product page and fit with the firm's established stationary shredding business make it a relatively credible option that should be retained for further learning.
